preferred_expl: Box-Cox MLE lambda=0.468 is the paper's central result; they present KWH^(1/2) because lambda is not significantly different from 0.5 and elasticities are easiest to interpret in that form, and they quote its -.42 elasticity first. reference: Munley, V. G., L. W. Taylor, and J. P. Formby (1990): "Electricity Demand in Multi-Family, Renter-Occupied Residences." Southern Economic Journal 57(1), 178-94
